summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing of INFORMASI KEPEGAWAIAN LAGUSIT. Backend: 36/36 pytest tests passing covering auth (JWT, 401/403 enforcement, super wildcard, 19-item menu), master data CRUD (all 8 collections), employee CRUD (search/pagination/enrichment/soft-delete/NIP dup), full attendance apel flow (event with APEL-YYYYMMDD-SESSION code, batch records, duplicate prevention via skipped list, correction with reason + 400 when empty, note upsert, documentation), personal + global attendance summary, RBAC users/roles/reset-password/permission enforcement, operator/evaluator assignments, KGB/Promotion status (aman/terlambat/days_left), announcements fan-out + notifications read-all, agenda range filter, evaluation template + evaluation auto-pulling attendance_percentage + approve, generic record modules (documents/leave/training/awards/discipline), dashboard admin stats, audit log (LOGIN present), global search. Frontend: Landing->Login->Dashboard works, sidebar shows 19 nav items for super admin, dashboard shows 8 stat cards, Employees list renders 3 seeded pegawai, Add Employee modal opens, Attendance apel create-event modal fills and submits, redirects to detail page with 4 tabs (informasi/kehadiran/notula/dokumentasi), Input Kehadiran modal lists employees with status dropdown and save-batch-btn, Users page tabs, Master Data tab pills (master-tab-*), Audit Log table shows 30 rows.

issues: Radix DialogContent emits a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription for accessibility compliance.

action_items: (Optional/polish) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to all shadcn/radix Dialogs to silence a11y warnings.

(Hardening) backend CORS config has allow_credentials=True with wildcard allow_origins='*' (from env default). Browsers reject credentialed requests from wildcard origins. Current app works because frontend uses Bearer header, but if cookie-based auth is ever used from a browser, set explicit CORS_ORIGINS in /app/backend/.env.
(Minor) dashboard.py kgb_due/promo_due currently count ALL records (dead code block retained) instead of only those near due; refine thresholding using _days_left.
critical_code_review_comments: security.py get_current_user accepts token from cookie `access_token` as well — good for same-site cookie usage but note CORS caveat above.

attendance.compute_event_recap and employee_summary issue many per-record find_one lookups for status; consider caching status map once per request (already done per helper call) — acceptable scale for small facility.

modules.make_record_router inner functions share identical path prefix via decorators — all route names collide (`_list`, `_create`) but FastAPI uses path for routing so OK. Minor: operation_id autogen may clash across routers for OpenAPI docs; consider setting unique name.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login beyond per-ip+email counter — fine for MVP; counter persists until successful login (also fine).
Login lockout counter resets `locked_until` on every failed attempt (even before reaching MAX_ATTEMPTS), effectively extending lockout window with each miss. Not a bug but could be documented.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed added. Each test cleans up its own TEST_* data. 3 seeded employees (198001/198002/198003) and seeded roles/types/statuses used as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_lagusit_api.py (pytest, uses pytest-xdist). Run: `cd /app && pytest backend/tests/test_lagusit_api.py -v`. All 36 cases green. Frontend verified via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. data-testids present: nav-* (19), master-tab-*, field-*, submit-event, tab-informasi/kehadiran/notula/dokumentasi, input-attendance-btn, save-batch-btn, create-event-btn, add-employee-btn, login-* , global-search-input, notification-bell, user-menu.
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. Only 2 initial test failures were caused by my test fixture using '.local' TLD which pydantic EmailStr rejects — fixed by switching to example.com.
